scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('data')) { fs.mkdirSync('dist/data', { recursive: true }); fs.readdirSync('data').forEach(f => { if (fs.statSync('data/' + f).isFile()) fs.copyFileSync('data/' + f, 'dist/data/' + f); }); console.log('Database snapshot files copied into build successfully.'); }"
